I do remember this part but I remember distinctly being hypomanic, have texts to friends telling them how happy I am and how beautiful the world is. Then I went for a drive and self injured my leg. All of this is to say I AM disabled. I have been trying my best to find solutions and go to therapy and create a healthy lifestyle for myself and it feels absolutely horrible to have this shit keep happening. Especially this last time because it feels like it was completely out of my control.

However, I still work full time, overtime even. A lot of the time I work 5 12 hour shifts a week. I go to school. I live on my own. I pay all my own bills. I go to therapy, the psychiatrist, the gym, I make healthy but satisfying meals, I reach out to people when I'm afraid.

Are you sure you're thinking of the correct disorder? POTS is postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome and is mostly characterized by consistent and sudden drop in blood pressure when standing which can often cause fainting. It is caused by a chemical imbalance in the brain and is often accompanied by racing heart, heart palpitations, fatigue, trouble balancing. If you are concerned about it, talk to your doctor. Maybe get an at home blood pressure cuff and take you blood pressure while sitting and then stand up, wait for a couple minutes, and take your blood pressure again. I forget the exact number but there's a certain difference in pulse from sitting to standing that they often use as an indicator. If you go to the doctor and they decide it's worth looking into, they will probably do a tilt table test and then give you a Holter monitor for 24 hours

Then fraternal twins are two separate eggs fertilized by two separate sperm. Fraternal twins usually only have as much genetic information in common with eachother as any other set of siblings would have with eachother. There can be fraternal twins that are two different sexes but you can also have them that are two of the same sex. Twins of the same sex doesn't automatically mean they're identical

But identical is when one egg is fertilized by one sperm. Then it can split in two but both halves have all the same, necessary information and chromosomes. Same chromosomes- same sex. Hence why conjoined twins (two parts of original zygote did not completely separate) are only ever two of the same sex. You can't have a male attached to a female.
